title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Anbu reveals to Jeeva that Kanmani is his wife after Jeeva's confession enrages him. He is heartbroken when Kanmani declares she has moved on from their marital relationship.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: After Rishi drives Viji out for opposing him, Paraman takes her to his home. Fearing their hidden mother-son truth will surface, Kalamma urges Rishi to bring his mother back.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vasundra instructs Abinaya to avoid Santhi's baby shower,  as everyone may question her about her life. She then publicly insults Abinaya when Santhi calls her to wear bangles.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Azhagar doubts Manjamalai's quiet behavior at the function. Sudalai, Rasathi, and Manjamalai plot to skip the wedding with Poongodi while Mohana checks the horoscopes.

title: Sindhu Bairavi
description: Sindhu warns Sneha with Shyam's truth, forcing her to withdraw accusations against Siva and hold a press meet. Later, an overjoyed Sindhu thanks Annapurani for her support.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Bagyaraj and Suresh support Mathi through bitter conflict, forcing Lakshmi to storm off in anger. Later, Suresh blames Mathi, but she fiercely defends herself.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Senthil reveals Saravanan's doctor visit and mental distress to Pandian. Later, Pandian calms Saravanan from starting a public fight and guides his future.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chozhan struggles as the new house owner refuses to return his advance money. Later, Pallavan officially joins and begins attending his new government exam coaching classes.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Enraged by Vijaya's request to abort Rohini's pregnancy, Parvathy firmly refuses to commit the sinful act. Muthu enrolls Seetha in karate training for self-defense against Arun.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Sethupathi rejects the divine prophecy proving Tamilselvi's innocence and demands proof. Aishwarya is terrified by a vision of God Karuppu, urging her to reveal the truth.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Madhu removes the thaali tied by Arjun and throws it at him, condemning the forced marriage. Later, Swetha demands that Arjun marry her as redemption for rejecting her.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Murugan trails Arivalagan, trying to find his weakness and avoid apologising. Kandhasamy approaches Arivalagan to apologise, hoping to get his mess reopened.
